pages.raw_meta: Match Group is the global leader behind Tinder, Hinge, and other leading dating brands, helping millions worldwide build meaningful connections.
raw_blocks: Powering Meaningful Connections at Global Scale
Across cultures, communities, and every stage of life.
Our Mission is to Spark Meaningful Connections for Every Single Person Worldwide

We know that connection looks different for everyone, which is why we build and support a portfolio of brands, each designed to meet people where they are and help them connect in ways that feel right for them.
The World’s Most Diverse Dating Portfolio
How We Design for Connection
We design experiences that meet people where they are — whether they’re exploring, seeking clarity, or looking for community.
Intentional paths to meaningful relationships.
Spaces built around shared identity.
Different brands. One shared mission.
Built for Exploration and Discovery
Designed for Clarity and Commitment
Created for Shared Culture and Community
Built to Lead Modern Connection
A global team building thoughtful, scalable solutions for modern connection.
Match Group apps facilitate nearly half a billion matches every month.
Designed to serve diverse communities across cultures and regions.
Built into our apps to promote trust, accountability, and protection at scale.
Trust and Safety Are Foundational to What We Do
Connection only works when people feel safe.

Meaningful connection starts with trust. Across our portfolio, safety, privacy, and user protection are built into how our products are designed and how our teams operate, from proactive detection to clear policies and ongoing investment in user trust.
Thoughtful innovation guides how we approach AI.

We believe generative AI can help create more engaging, inclusive, and safer experiences across our platforms. Our approach is grounded in responsible innovation, with a focus on transparency, accountability, and user trust.

Built to Lead Modern Connection
500 million matches are facilitated by Match Group's apps every month.
2,000+ employees in 20 offices worldwide.
1/3 of marriages begin on an app.

Behind every product are teams of people who care deeply about the impact of their work. Across brands, functions, and geographies, our teams collaborate to solve complex challenges around human connection.
Sr. Manager, Globalization & International Growth, Product Operations
Leading a global team across dozens of languages has pushed me to grow as a leader and think more strategically about how we connect people around the world.
Every day, we’re working behind the scenes to remove bad actors so people have a real chance at finding meaningful connection. Ideally, users never know we exist — it just means we’ve done our job.
